The issue: I call `solver.pop()` before accessing `solver.model()` in the witness section. Let me fix: get the model before popping.

In the witness section:
```python
solver.push()
solver.add(z3.BoolVal(True))
r = solver.check()
solver.pop()
if r != z3.sat: return None
model = solver.model()
```
→ need to fetch the model before pop. Let me restructure.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/submission && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='/workspace/submission/analyze.py'
s=open(p).read()
old = """        solver.push()
        solver.add(z3.BoolVal(True))
        r = solver.check()
        solver.pop()
        if r != z3.sat:
            return None
        model = solver.model()
"""
new = """        solver.push()
        solver.add(z3.BoolVal(True))
        r = solver.check()
        if r != z3.sat:
            solver.pop()
            return None
        model = solver.model()
        solver.pop()
"""
assert old in s
s=s.replace(old,new)
